description: React component for displaying and toggling the published status of a dashboard, with tooltips and labels indicating whether the dashboard is published or a draft.

classes.name: PublishedStatus
classes.description: React component class that manages the display and toggling of dashboard published status.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component and binds the togglePublished method.

methods.name: togglePublished
methods.description: Calls the savePublished prop to toggle the dashboard's published state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI based on the published status and user permissions, including tooltips and labels.
